name: Clockwork: Scale/Rotate petals, ConcatTransform, Transform, mirror Scale, CoordSysTransform
description: Petals from a sphere under non-uniform Scale and Rotate, a star placed by ConcatTransform, a pennant and its mirror image (Scale -1 1 1), a spiral staircase built by accumulating Rotate + Translate with its top named by CoordinateSystem and reused by CoordSysTransform, and a ring of cubes in a frame set by an absolute Transform. Checks the whole transform stack.
